description: A STANDING self-improvement concern, as graph data — not a human typing text mid-session. scripts/jabberwock_improves_itself.py / jabberwock_varies_itself.py / jabberwock_varies_acting.py have always driven the self-experiment loop by hand-calling domains.reflective_faculty.induce_concern(agent, [["test",...],["send",...],["judge",...],["gradient",...],["adopt",...]]) with this EXACT relation-cue vocabulary (the checked-in RelationCue lexicon in seeds/relation_vocabulary.json is what grounds these words; nothing here is novel vocabulary). This seed carries that same structured observation as a StandingConcern node so the daemon's mechanical _concern_tick hook (scripts/jabberwock_daemon.py) can feed it through induce_concern/ground_concern once per agent lifetime, with no human in the loop. Whether it MINTS a CapabilityAxis (Covers=False, a genuine residual on THIS agent's held term-shapes) or is RECOGNIZED (Covers=True, already covered by something the agent learned) is entirely the seeded shape_decode_loop rules' decision, not this file's; which composer it grounds to (composer_dispatch.json's Argmin-priority Program) and which mint/judge/adopt rules get authored from it is entirely ground_concern's + _compose_experiment_rule's decision. This file only supplies WHAT to observe, exactly once, as data — never WHAT to conclude.
